story.這一組叫「無禮之刑」，熟了以後說話容易太直接，記得保留一點客氣: this pair is called the “punishment of rudeness”: once you are close, you may speak too bluntly, so keep a little courtesy
story.這一組叫「無恩之刑」，付出時容易覺得沒被看見，把感謝說出口就好: this pair is called the “punishment of ingratitude”: you may feel your efforts go unseen, so just say thank you out loud
story.這一組叫「恃勢之刑」，兩人都想作主，事先分好誰負責哪些事就好: this pair is called the “punishment of power”: you may both want to be in charge, so just agree beforehand who looks after what

story.先天的契合是好的起點，日常的體貼與溝通，才能讓這些優點一直發揮。: A natural fit is a good start; everyday thoughtfulness and talking things through are what keep those strengths working.
story.這樣的組合沒有太大的先天起伏，感情的溫度多半取決於兩人日常的經營。: A pairing like this has no great built-in highs or lows; the warmth of the relationship depends mostly on how the two of you tend it day to day.
story.磨合不是壞事：步調不同的兩個人，只要願意溝通、給彼此空間，差異反而能變成互補。: Working things out is no bad thing: two people with different paces who are willing to talk and give each other room can turn their differences into a way of complementing each other.
story.這些是傳統命理的看法，兩人怎麼選擇、怎麼相處，影響更大。: These are the views of traditional BaZi; the choices you make and how you treat each other matter more.
story.每週留一段只屬於兩個人的時間，不談工作和家務，聊聊彼此最近的心情。: Keep some time each week just for the two of you: no talk of work or chores, just how each of you has been feeling lately.
story.重要的決定（工作、搬家、理財）攤開來一起談，先說各自的期待與擔心，再一起決定。: Talk big decisions (work, moving house, money) through openly together: first say what each of you hopes for and worries about, then decide together.
